records.issue_text: [BUG] The deletion of the promOnlyRules rendering removes the 'Deleting' placeholder for rules removed from the Ruler but still present in Prometheus, so stale rules render as fully live rules with full action menus. Users on the rule list see deleted rules as active and can attempt Edit/Silence/Duplicate against rules whose ruler definition no longer exists, producing 404s from the edit page; previously these rows were clearly marked Deleting with no actions.

records.issue_text: [BUG] The new GrafanaRuleListItem drops the createReturnTo() parameter that the old GrafanaRuleLoader version passed to createRelativeUrl, so the rule href loses the returnTo query param. Users who click a rule name in the list, then click Edit from the rule view, are no longer returned to their filtered list position (pagination/scroll/filter state) — the old href preserved it; this is a regression in navigation fidelity for every list-view click.
records.rationale: The diff removes the prior `returnTo` wiring for Grafana-managed rule list items. In the deleted `GrafanaRuleLoader.tsx`, `GrafanaRuleListItem` built the href as `createRelativeUrl(`/alerting/grafana/${uid}/view`, { returnTo })` using `createReturnTo()`. The new `GrafanaRuleListItem.tsx` constructs `href: createRelativeUrl(`/alerting/grafana/${uid}/view`)` with no `returnTo` parameter, and `GrafanaGroupLoader`/`FilterView` now render this new component. This is a concrete navigation behavior regression, and the updated tests only assert the base path (no query params), so the loss is unguarded

records.issue_text: [ADVISORY] useAllRulerRuleAbilities hard-codes isFederated = false where the CombinedRule-based original used isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group), so the deprecated useAllAlertRuleAbilities shim silently re-enables Delete/Update on federated rule groups it previously disabled. Any caller still on the deprecated useAllAlertRuleAbilities path (Mimir federated groups) gets Delete buttons on rules that cannot actually be deleted server-side — the user hits a 400/403 after clicking; the TODO comment confirms this is a known regression shipped to the deprecated entry point.
records.rationale: In `useAllRulerRuleAbilities` the previous federated immutability logic is explicitly removed: the import of `isFederatedRuleGroup` is dropped and the code now hardcodes `const isFederated = false;` with a TODO (`// TODO: Add support for federated rules`). This means `immutableRule = isProvisioned || isFederated || isPluginProvided` will never treat federated rule groups as immutable anymore, so Edit/Delete/Duplicate support can be incorrectly enabled for federated Mimir groups compared to the prior behavior.

records.issue_text: [BUG] useAllAlertRuleAbilities now delegates to useAllRulerRuleAbilities where isFederated is hardcoded to false (with a TODO), whereas the previous implementation called isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group) — the federated-rule immutability guard is silently dropped. Federated rule groups (Mimir feature) that previously rendered as immutable now get editable/deletable ability results: users see Edit/Delete buttons, click them, and the operation then fails server-side — a user-facing action whose guard was removed with no error or indication at the permission-check stage.

This means `immutableRule = isProvisioned || isFederated || isPluginProvided` will never treat federated rule groups as immutable anymore, so Edit/Delete/Duplicate support can be incorrectly enabled for federated Mimir groups compared to the prior behavior.
